A group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] cultists dressed in [[Color/Legends|red]] robes with golden accents, '''Force Pilgrims''' spectated the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]] on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[3626 BBY]]. Some pilgrims were dressed in dark red, holding a gnarled wooden staff and possessing a golden pendant, while other [[The Force/Legends|Force]] cultists wore red [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with an orange trim. Nevertheless, across the differences in attire, the pilgrims wore a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] of the same design in addition to a plaque.

==History==
Force Pilgrims were a group of cultists<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210302-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 6.2.1}}</ref> founded by [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], several Force Pilgrims were aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Carrick Station]] as well as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]], viewing a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] announcement for the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]]. Two Force Pilgrims spectated the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] event on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], standing in a camp site near the starting and finishing lines as others partook in the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race.<ref name="Swoop" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Such racers included [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Swoop" />
{{Endgame}}

==Members and attire==
The pilgrims were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who wore [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] that concealed thir faces. Both [[Gender/Legends|males]] and females made up [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] cultists' ranks. The pilgrims had a uniform dark red robed-and-hooded [[Clothing/Legends|attire]] with gold accents, and some amongst them held wooden staffs that featured a gray [[Lamp/Legends|lamp]] that glowed a luminous yellow towards the top, the lamp being hung from an arch, one side of which circled down to the straight trunk of the wooden staff. The staff was gnarled and featured red and black and white and black stripes. The left of the hood's base, which was affixed over the upper chest of the wearer, displayed a golden plaque.<ref name="Swoop" />

[[File:ForcePilgrimArmor.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Force Pilgrim in the red and orange armor.]]
In addition, the pilgrims wore dark red shoes and gloves, the latter of which had gold markings, thus covering their entire body with garments with the exception of their necks. As part of their attire, pilgrims wore flowing leg coverings, draping, dark purple cloth extending along the arms, a black undertunic, a red overtunic with golden markings across the chest, as well as a belt that hung a golden pendant. The relief of the pendant bore an asymmetric image.<ref name="Swoop" /> The overtunic was similar to a [[Port Nowhere]] mobster's [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and both shared the same gold markings.<ref name="Mobster">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170426|text=Cartel Market Specials: Week of April 24, 2017}}</ref>

However, a Force Pilgrim could also wear a similar armor attire that had a red and orange color scheme as opposed to dark red and gold. It replaced the flowing leg coverings with a dress, featured no draping cloth along the arms, lacking the torso covering that had golden markings across the chest, and without the belt showcasing the golden pendant. Instead, a gray belt with a metallic, bronze device was worn around the waist, and a pair of gray, metal gloves was worn over red bracers encircled by a golden ring.<ref name="Swoop" /><ref name="TORweb" />

==Behind the scenes==
Force Pilgrims appear in the [[2020]] Update 6.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', a digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Swoop" /> They were first identified in an update released in [[2021]], with screenshots depicting a Force Pilgrim wielding a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on Dantooine.<ref name="TORweb" /> The appearance of Force Pilgrims is similar to [[Silvanie Phest]],<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> a character of the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] that was introduced in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
